newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Ecuador refinery maintenance extended by 2 weeks.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador refinery maintenance extended by 2 weeks.

text.p: A planned stoppage of Ecuador's main Esmeraldas oil refinery was extended by two weeks and the plant is now expected back on stream Sept 1, a Petroecuador source said on Monday.

The refinery had been due back on Aug 18 after 45 days' maintenance which included increasing throughput capacity from 90,000 barrel per day (bpd) to 110,000 bpd. The maintenance has been extended by 14 days to 60 days.
"That's a bit of a delay," the source said.

The refinery, 200 miles (320 km) northwest of Quito, used to export about 37,000 bpd of diesel and gasoline. During the stoppage, a new 16,000 bpd fluid catalytic cracker will be fitted to produce unleaded, low sulphur gasoline.
